aboutoman.text.2: The Sultanate of Oman offers a stable and attractive environment for long-term investment.
aboutoman.text.3:
The Sultanate of Oman offers a stable and attractive environment for long-term investment. With a strong tradition of political stability, prudent economic governance, and a strategic geographic location connecting global markets, Oman has become an increasingly important destination for regional and international investors.

Supported by Oman Vision 2040, the country is actively advancing economic diversification, innovation, and private sector development across key industries.

These national priorities continue to strengthen Oman’s position as a gateway for investment, trade, and sustainable economic growth.
aboutoman.infra.title: Infrastructure Advantage
aboutoman.infra.desc: The Sultanate of Oman has developed world-class infrastructure that supports global commerce and economic growth. This includes international airports, deep-water ports, modern highway networks, and expanding digital connectivity.
aboutoman.legislation.title: Progressive Legislation
aboutoman.legislation.desc: Recent regulatory reforms have strengthened Oman’s investment environment. Investors benefit from simplified licensing procedures, transparent regulatory frameworks, and the ability to hold full foreign ownership in many sectors.
aboutoman.ecosystem.title: Dynamic Business Ecosystem
aboutoman.ecosystem.desc: Oman offers a dynamic business environment supported by industrial zones, free zones, and technology hubs. These platforms provide investors with infrastructure, regulatory incentives, and access to regional and international markets.
aboutoman.location.title: The Strategic Edge
aboutoman.location.desc: Oman is strategically positioned at the crossroads of major global trade routes connecting Asia, Africa, and Europe. This geographic advantage enables businesses to access international markets efficiently while benefiting from strong regional connectivity.
aboutoman.hub.title: Cost-Effective Global Hub
aboutoman.hub.desc: Compared with many international markets, Oman offers competitive operating costs while maintaining high-quality infrastructure and strong access to global markets.
aboutoman.incentives.title: Incentives to Invest
aboutoman.incentives.desc:
The Sultanate of Oman offers a supportive and competitive environment for investors seeking long-term opportunities across strategic sectors. Over the past decade, the country has implemented significant economic reforms and investment policies designed to encourage international investment and private sector growth.

Key advantages for investors include:

•	Competitive Tax Environment – Oman maintains an attractive corporate tax framework with incentives designed to support business development and long-term investment.
•	Access to Free Zones and Special Economic Zones – Investors benefit from well-established economic hubs such as Duqm Special Economic Zone, Sohar Freezone, and Salalah Free Zone. These zones provide world-class infrastructure, investment incentives, and streamlined regulatory procedures.
•	Government Support for Strategic Industries – The government continues to encourage investment in sectors aligned with national economic diversification priorities, including energy, logistics, tourism, manufacturing, technology, and infrastructure.
•	Investor-Friendly Legislation – Modern regulatory reforms, including the Oman Foreign Capital Investment Law, provide enhanced protections for investors, simplified licensing procedures, and allow foreign investors to hold full ownership in many sectors.
•	Strategic Economic Vision – Oman’s national development framework under Oman Vision 2040 aims to diversify the economy, strengthen the private sector, and attract global investment.

These advantages position Oman as a stable and attractive destination for long-term investment and strategic partnerships.

home.text.2: Private Investment House & Strategic Development Platform
home.text.3:
Shomoukh International Investment is a privately held investment company established in the Sultanate of Oman in 2006 by the Al Hashmi family. The firm operates as both an investment company and a strategic development platform focused on identifying and developing high-value opportunities across strategic sectors.

For nearly two decades, the organization has focused on building and managing investments that contribute to sustainable economic growth and long-term value creation.

Through its diversified portfolio and international partnerships, Shomoukh International Investment connects capital, expertise, and opportunities across Oman and global markets while supporting innovation and economic development.

Headquartered in Muscat, the firm continues to expand its investment activities across emerging industries and international markets.

keysectors.energy.overview: Oman is rapidly transitioning to long-term energy sustainability, combining its strong oil and gas foundation with a massive focus on renewable energy.
keysectors.energy.potential: Limitless growth opportunities in multi-billion dollar solar and wind farm projects, green hydrogen infrastructure, and long-duration energy storage solutions.
keysectors.energy.future: Targeting 100% clean energy for industrial zones by 2040 and positioning Oman as a top 3 global green hydrogen exporter.
keysectors.energy.goal: Become the regional leader in carbon-neutral industrial manufacturing.
keysectors.luxury.overview: High-end tourism, exclusive lifestyle projects, and premium lifestyle developments are reshaping Oman’s luxury sector.
keysectors.luxury.potential: Developing ultra-luxury resorts, exclusive mixed-use communities, and premium retail destinations.
keysectors.luxury.future: Attracting high-net-worth individuals and establishing Oman as the premier luxury destination in the region.
keysectors.trade.overview: Oman is a historic maritime powerhouse, now functioning as a modern regional trade hub with exceptional free zones.
keysectors.trade.potential: Incentivized free zones (Sohar, Salalah, Duqm) providing 100% foreign ownership and zero customs duties.
keysectors.trade.future: Expanding multi-modal connectivity to cement Oman’s position as the primary gateway linking Asia, Africa, and the MENA region.
keysectors.investments.overview: Oman’s robust financial services sector supports large-scale development projects and corporate growth.
keysectors.investments.potential: Opportunities in wealth management, fintech, venture capital, and sovereign-backed infrastructure projects.
keysectors.investments.future: A modernized, digitized financial ecosystem driving cross-border investments and massive sovereign wealth allocation.
keysectors.tourism.overview: From diverse landscapes to deeply rooted heritage, Oman offers authentic and sustainable tourism experiences.
keysectors.tourism.potential: Developing eco-resorts, adventure tourism, heritage sites, and premium coastal developments.
keysectors.tourism.future: Vision 2040 aims for tourism to contribute significantly to the GDP, drawing millions of international visitors annually.
keysectors.education.overview: Building a knowledge-based economy requires top-tier educational institutions and vocational training centers.
keysectors.education.potential: Establishing international universities, specialized research centers, and future-ready vocational programs.
keysectors.education.future: A highly skilled, innovative local workforce driving Oman’s global competitiveness and knowledge export.
keysectors.logistics.overview: Oman’s world-class ports and seamless shipping routes form the backbone of the nation’s logistics advantage.
keysectors.logistics.potential: Investing in port expansion, cold chain logistics, rail networks, and integrated warehousing facilities.
keysectors.logistics.future: Transforming into a top 10 global logistics hub, providing uninterrupted global supply chain connectivity.
keysectors.realestate.overview: An expanding population and an influx of international investors are driving robust commercial and residential demand.
keysectors.realestate.potential: Commercial centers, sustainable residential communities, and futuristic smart-city developments (like Sultan Haitham City).
keysectors.realestate.future: A thriving, sustainable urban landscape meeting global standards of living and commercial operational excellence.
keysectors.technology.overview: Oman is positioning itself as a regional tech hub, with significant investments in AI, data centers, and digital infrastructure.
keysectors.technology.potential: Establishing cloud-region data centers, AI development clusters, and specialized high-tech manufacturing in silicon and semiconductors.
keysectors.technology.future: A fully autonomous digital economy powered by local AI and edge computing solutions.
keysectors.technology.goal: Achieve 10% pure-tech contribution to national GDP by 2040.
keysectors.privateequity.overview: The private equity market in Oman is expanding, offering high-growth opportunities for institutional and private investors.
keysectors.privateequity.potential: Focused investments in manufacturing, healthcare, and education sectors through strategic equity participation.
keysectors.privateequity.future: A robust private equity ecosystem driving corporate maturity and supporting the Sultanate's broader economic diversification goals.
leadership.chairman.name: The Honorable Sheikh Salim Hamood Said Al Hashmi
leadership.chairman.title: Chairman
leadership.chairman.message_text:
For centuries, the Sultanate of Oman has stood as a bridge between civilizations. From its shores, merchants, scholars, and travelers connected the great regions of Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas, shaping a legacy of openness, dialogue, and peaceful exchange.

It is within this enduring spirit that Shomoukh International Investment was founded. Our purpose has always been guided by the belief that investment should contribute not only to economic progress, but also to the development of vibrant communities and sustainable opportunities for future generations.

Today, under the visionary leadership of His Majesty Sultan Haitham bin Tarik Al Said, the Sultanate continues to advance a forward-looking agenda that strengthens economic diversification, innovation, and global partnership. Oman occupies a unique position in the world—geographically, historically, and culturally. Located at the crossroads of global trade routes, the country continues to strengthen its role as a center for cooperation, investment, and responsible development.

Through our investments and strategic partnerships, we seek to support this national journey by developing ventures that foster innovation, strengthen industries, and contribute to long-term prosperity. We remain committed to building partnerships across borders and investing in opportunities that reflect the values of cooperation, progress, and shared prosperity.

As we look to the future, our ambition remains clear: to contribute to a world where opportunity is expanded, communities thrive, and Oman continues to stand as a place where cultures, ideas, and markets meet.

The Honorable Sheikh Salim Hamood Said Al Hashmi
Chairman
